WITH
  -- Pull only the rows we need, pushing the time filter down early
  filtered AS (
    SELECT timestamp, value
    FROM process_metrics
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
      AND station_name = 'ced_station'
      AND metric_name = 'entry_stopper_lowering_time'
  ),
  -- Single index lookup for baseline — fetched once, not per row
  baseline AS (
    SELECT mean, std_dev
    FROM baseline_metrics
    WHERE station_name = 'ced_station'
      AND metric_name = 'entry_stopper_lowering_time'
    LIMIT 1
  )
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(f.timestamp, $__interval),
  avg(f.value)                        AS "value",
  min(b.mean + 3 * b.std_dev)         AS "UCL (+3σ)",
  min(b.mean - 3 * b.std_dev)         AS "LCL (-3σ)",
  min(b.mean)                         AS "Mean"
FROM filtered f
CROSS JOIN baseline b
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

WITH
  filtered AS (
    SELECT timestamp, value
    FROM process_metrics
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
      AND station_name = 'ced_station'
      AND metric_name = 'entry_stopper_lowering_time'
  ),
  baseline AS (
    SELECT mean, std_dev
    FROM baseline_metrics
    WHERE station_name = 'ced_station'
      AND metric_name = 'entry_stopper_lowering_time'
    LIMIT 1
  ),
  bucketed AS (
    SELECT
      $__timeGroupAlias(f.timestamp, $__interval),
      avg(f.value)                    AS avg_val,
      min(b.mean + 3 * b.std_dev)     AS ucl,
      min(b.mean - 3 * b.std_dev)     AS lcl
    FROM filtered f
    CROSS JOIN baseline b
    GROUP BY time
  )
SELECT
  time,
  CASE
    WHEN avg_val > ucl OR avg_val < lcl THEN avg_val
    ELSE NULL
  END AS "Anomaly"
FROM bucketed
ORDER BY time
